**[P1] Defer retryable errors until cleanup checks revocation**

This re-raises inside the `with` block. If an asynchronous checkpoint returns without a token while the context managers unwind, revocation is recorded after this check; the post-cleanup override is skipped and Lambda retries with the revoked invocation token. Capture the exception, finish checkpoint-thread cleanup, then return bare `PENDING` if revocation occurred; otherwise re-raise. Add a test racing a retryable `InvocationError` with a tokenless async checkpoint.
